title: London — individually researched facade studies
units: metres; facadeBearing clockwise degrees from geographic north
scope: First 25 individual OSM footprints plus explicitly inferred street fallbacks. This is not a full survey or a claim of exact present-day facade reconstruction.

evidencePolicy.verified-features: Only listed verifiedFeatures are directly evidenced. Numeric colours and geometric simplifications are always estimates.
evidencePolicy.inferred: Identity, footprint and some material evidence are known; detailed facade design has not been verified.
evidencePolicy.signs: A sign field is a building/venue name at a confirmed footprint, not a reproduction of current commercial typography or a show poster.

relation/5208404.name: Buckingham Palace
relation/5208404.facadeBearingEvidence: Approximate east-front normal facing Victoria Memorial, consistent with the existing landmark placement.
verifiedFeatures: East elevation has a 3:7:3:7:3 bay rhythm.
Three main storeys, Corinthian detailing and a continuous first-floor balcony.
inferredFeatures: Exact colours, heights where absent from OSM, window dimensions, secondary elevations and simplified ornamental geometry are artistic approximations.

way/4266528.name: Carlton House Terrace — western block
way/4266528.facadeBearingEvidence: Estimated normal towards nearest The Mall road segment; not survey-measured.
verifiedFeatures: OSM footprint is the western terrace of Nos 1–9, not the demolished Carlton House.
Stucco and slate; park elevation follows five groups of 5:8:5:8:5.
inferredFeatures: Exact colours, heights where absent from OSM, window dimensions, secondary elevations and simplified ornamental geometry are artistic approximations.
way/4266528.notes: Keep the complete terrace rhythm on its long park face; do not repeat 31 bays on every short edge.
